Product Features

  • Modern Black LED Coffee Table: This black acrylic LED coffee table adds a touch of tech to your space with its simple, streamlined design and LED lighting. This coffee table will match any color scheme.

Over 60,000 colors and various DIY modes are available to choose from to make your home shine. It is the ideal place for a party and ensures a pleasant time even if you are staying home alone.
  • Multifunctional Modern Coffee Table: This modern coffee table is versatile. It can be used as a coffee table, snack table, coffee table, etc. The LED light brightens up your room and makes it brighter. This coffee table is widely used in homes and is perfect as a coffee table, desk, etc.
  • Large Storage Space: The double-layer modern coffee table gives you enough space to display various accessories or items such as magazines, books, remote controls or other living room utensils, keeping the desk neat and organized
  • Versatile and versatile: this piece of furniture can be used as a table to place objects such as books or drinks, or as task lighting for reading or enhancing the ambience of a room. Our living room tables are ideal for home decoration
  • Sturdy and Elegant: With its generous size and thoughtful rectangular base, our black LED coffee table is not only stylish but also stable. Say goodbye to wobbly tables, our thoughtful design ensures a stable stand. It fits in any living room and has an open shelf for extra storage space. The double drawers make it easy to organize your everyday items.
  • Upgrade your space: Its sleek design and seamless construction are a perfect match for modern aesthetics. The LED lighting of the table adds a touch of innovation and elegance to your living space, instantly enhancing the overall ambience and creating a stylish eye-catcher.
  • Easy to assemble: This modern LED coffee table measures 100 x 50 x 42 cm and has a maximum load capacity of 30 kg. Assembly is very easy if you follow the assembly instructions.
  • Multiple Organization Areas: The living room table has an open display shelf that provides ample space for your daily necessities and includes 2 flexible sliding drawers to store accessories or books, keeping your living room organized and suitable for any type of living room or conference room.
  • The perfect combination of modern style and functionality: This rectangular coffee table with its modern design and simple look is the perfect choice for those who value style and functionality and fits perfectly into any living room. Thanks to its functionality, it will remain a treasure for years to come, whether you're hosting a party, watching a movie, or just relaxing with a cup of coffee.
